cli: endpoint_reuse --run FIXTURES.tsv PUBLIC_TARGETS.tsv SETTINGS.tsv ARM FRESH_OUTPUT.jsonl
event_order: For harvest: terminal* then verified_solution (only after upstream equation check), harvest_proposal* then harvest_commit_ready then final target. Ready/proposals are NOT active until target.harvest_committed=true. Failed targets discard pending entries.
active_state: Sorted known prefix contains only canonical verified-known exponents. Pending(fp,a) slots lie beyond nent and are never searched. Exactpointdedup by e modulo primeorderr.
primary_counter: counters.group_additions counts every shared Ops.add invocation once, including doubles and identity cases. Scalar-multiplication calls are nested and must not be added.
timing: No clocks emitted; internal upstream seconds excluded. No L2 qualification asserted.
memory_scope: Exact requested persistent arena/fixed arrays/object bytes, bounded build payload; allocator metadata, library setup-qsort scratch, pthread stack and process RSS separate. Candidate growth heapsort uses constant one-entry stack workspace. Strict arena cap includes known+pending. Raw streamed events are not an in-memory endpoint pool.

rng.seed_calls: seed initializations; each executes4source splitmix steps
rng.word_draws: xoshiro256** output words including rejection-sampling retries
rng.below_calls: bounded-draw requests; word draws nested, do not add

table_state_hash64: XOR over known entries of splitmix_finalizer(fp ^ rotl64(exponent,17) ^ 0x65726c61622d7631); empty0; audit digest not cryptographic integrity
fixed_capacity: All BL arms reserve exactly C 16-byte arena slots after build; original static lookup/RNG unchanged. Candidate pending shares unused slots. Static full requests C raw chains; others C0. Initial upstream fingerprint-only dedup preserved.
static_filled: Initial C0 raw-chain upstream table, then dedicated known-scalar walks until C distinct canonical exponents in same C-slot arena or explicit watchdog. Same S/DP map. Entire initial+fill counters charged; no target growth; partial censored table retained.

reported_precomp_guard.meaning: Settings max_precomp_ops caps total reported initial plus fill group work, not actual Ops.add or field work. Zero is unlimited group work but fill starts still finitely bounded.
reported_precomp_guard.setup_reported_upper: 21*(bitlen(r)-1): Gpow costs bitlen-1 doubles, each of20 nonzero adding scalars costs at most bitlen-1 fixed-base additions.
reported_precomp_guard.upstream_walk_budget: max_precomp_ops minus upper; if nonzero max<=upper censor before construction.
reported_precomp_guard.fill_remaining: max minus actual initial upstream_stats.reported_group_ops, check before every fill group operation.

parameter_scope: Setup parameters are actual BL settings; rho_reference explicitly marks BL parameters unused and rho_auto_requested=true. Its target row records the actual domain-separated rho_seed. Rho requests r=0,walks=0,dp_bits=-1,threads=1,negation_map=true and its own max_ops.
